title: JPMorgan and Goldman Underwrite Only $1.3B of $5B Volta AI Loan
summary:
The primary financial institutions managing a debt offering for AI startup Volta Infrastructure are refusing to guarantee the majority of the funds being raised. JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs have committed to underwriting only $1.3 billion of the $5 billion total loan sale, leaving the remaining $3.7 billion of the chip loan without an underwrite by either bank. The debt is currently being marketed at a yield of about 11%.

This rare restriction on risk reflects growing investor caution over the high cost of capital-intensive AI infrastructure. Lenders are demanding higher yields to offset the elevated financing risks associated with the sector's rapid expansion and infrastructure requirements.
